ex.zh: 部分工作由海外團隊完成。

ex.en: Import duty on cars is 20 percent.
ex.zh: 汽車進口關稅是 20%。

ex.en: You need an export license for these products.
ex.zh: 這些產品需要出口許可證。

ex.en: The two countries signed a trade agreement.
ex.zh: 兩國簽署了貿易協定。

ex.en: Free trade has lowered prices for consumers.
ex.zh: 自由貿易降低了消費者的價格。

ex.en: The government placed an embargo on oil exports.
ex.zh: 政府對石油出口實施禁運。

ex.en: The ship arrived at the port this morning.
ex.zh: 船今天早上抵達港口。

ex.en: The hotel has a view of the harbor.
ex.zh: 飯店看得到港灣景色。

ex.en: The ship docked at noon.
ex.zh: 船中午靠港。

ex.en: The goods are carried by container ship.
ex.zh: 貨物用貨櫃船運送。

ex.en: The parts were flown in by cargo plane.
ex.zh: 零件用貨機空運過來。

ex.en: Business travel has decreased since video calls became popular.
ex.zh: 視訊普及後商務旅行減少了。

ex.en: Please read the company travel policy.
ex.zh: 請閱讀公司差旅規定。

ex.en: Your travel itinerary has been emailed to you.
ex.zh: 你的行程表已寄到信箱。

ex.en: My assistant will make the travel arrangements.
ex.zh: 我的助理會安排行程。

ex.en: I'll make arrangements for your stay.
ex.zh: 我會安排你的住宿。

ex.en: It's cheaper to book in advance.
ex.zh: 提前預訂比較便宜。

ex.en: Advance booking is recommended.
ex.zh: 建議提前預訂。

ex.en: Online check-in opens 24 hours before the flight.
ex.zh: 線上報到在起飛前 24 小時開放。

ex.en: Please go to boarding gate 15.
ex.zh: 請前往 15 號登機門。

ex.en: There has been a gate change for flight 207.
ex.zh: 207 班機更換登機門。

ex.en: The departure time is 8:30 a.m.
ex.zh: 出發時間是早上八點半。

ex.en: What is the expected arrival time?
ex.zh: 預計抵達時間是幾點？

ex.en: Please check your flight number.
ex.zh: 請確認你的航班編號。

ex.en: You can check the flight status online.
ex.zh: 你可以上網查航班狀態。

ex.en: Passengers on the delayed flight received meal vouchers.
ex.zh: 延誤班機的乘客獲得餐券。

ex.en: Passengers on canceled flights can get a refund.
ex.zh: 班機取消的乘客可以退款。

ex.en: The flight was overbooked.
ex.zh: 這班飛機超賣了。

ex.en: We are on standby for the next flight.
ex.zh: 我們在候補下一班飛機。

ex.en: Frequent flyers can use the lounge.
ex.zh: 飛行常客可以使用貴賓室。

ex.en: You can use your mileage for a free ticket.
ex.zh: 你可以用哩程兌換免費機票。

ex.en: Earn loyalty points with every stay.
ex.zh: 每次入住都能累積點數。

ex.en: Business class tickets include lounge access.
ex.zh: 商務艙機票含貴賓室使用權。

ex.en: We waited in the airport lounge.
ex.zh: 我們在機場貴賓室等候。

ex.en: There was a long line at the security checkpoint.
ex.zh: 安檢處大排長龍。

ex.en: Fill out the customs declaration before landing.
ex.zh: 降落前請填寫海關申報單。

ex.en: Please hand the declaration form to the officer.
ex.zh: 請把申報表交給海關人員。

ex.en: Complete the immigration form on the plane.
ex.zh: 請在飛機上填好入境表格。

ex.en: Please fill out the arrival card.
ex.zh: 請填寫入境卡。

ex.en: The visa application takes two weeks.
ex.zh: 簽證申請需要兩週。

ex.en: Buy travel insurance before your trip.
ex.zh: 出發前請投保旅遊險。

ex.en: The government issued a travel advisory.
ex.zh: 政府發布了旅遊警示。

ex.en: London is in a different time zone.
ex.zh: 倫敦在不同的時區。

ex.en: We land at 6 p.m. local time.
ex.zh: 我們當地時間晚上六點降落。

ex.en: I'm still jet-lagged from the trip.
ex.zh: 我還在調時差。

ex.en: There are many accommodation options near the venue.
ex.zh: 會場附近有很多住宿選擇。

ex.en: The hotel chain has 300 locations.
ex.zh: 這家連鎖飯店有 300 個據點。

ex.en: We stayed at a small boutique hotel.
ex.zh: 我們住在一間小精品旅館。

ex.en: We stayed at a bed and breakfast in the countryside.
ex.zh: 我們住在鄉間的民宿。

ex.en: Serviced apartments are good for long stays.
ex.zh: 酒店式公寓適合長住。

ex.en: We offer special rates for extended stays.
ex.zh: 長期住宿享特別優惠。

ex.en: Can I request a late checkout?
ex.zh: 我可以申請延遲退房嗎？

ex.en: Early check-in is available for a fee.
ex.zh: 提早入住需另付費用。

ex.en: We got a free room upgrade.
ex.zh: 我們獲得免費房型升等。

ex.en: I'd like a room with an ocean view.
ex.zh: 我想要海景房。

ex.en: Our room had a great city view.
ex.zh: 我們的房間有很棒的市景。

ex.en: All our rooms are non-smoking rooms.
ex.zh: 我們所有房間都是禁菸房。

ex.en: The family booked two adjoining rooms.
ex.zh: 這家人訂了兩間相連房。

ex.en: The hotel has excellent conference facilities.
ex.zh: 飯店有完善的會議設施。

ex.en: You can print documents at the business center.
ex.zh: 你可以在商務中心列印文件。

ex.en: The hotel provides a free shuttle service.
ex.zh: 飯店提供免費接駁服務。

ex.en: The airport shuttle leaves every 30 minutes.
ex.zh: 機場接駁車每 30 分鐘一班。

ex.en: Car rental is available at the airport.
ex.zh: 機場可以租車。

ex.en: Read the rental agreement before you sign.
ex.zh: 簽名前請閱讀租賃協議。

ex.en: Pick up your keys at the rental counter.
ex.zh: 請在租車櫃台領取鑰匙。

ex.en: The fuel policy is full-to-full.
ex.zh: 油料規定是滿油取車滿油還車。

ex.en: This rental has no mileage limit.
ex.zh: 這次租車沒有里程限制。

ex.en: The taxi stand is outside the main exit.
ex.zh: 計程車招呼站在大門出口外。

ex.en: Ride-sharing apps are popular in big cities.
ex.zh: 叫車軟體在大城市很普及。

ex.en: The office is easy to reach by public transit.
ex.zh: 搭大眾運輸很容易到辦公室。

ex.en: Buy a travel card for unlimited rides.
ex.zh: 買交通卡可無限次搭乘。

ex.en: A day pass costs $10.
ex.zh: 一日券 10 美元。

ex.en: We took a sightseeing tour of the city.
ex.zh: 我們參加了市區觀光行程。

ex.en: The hotel offers guided excursions to the mountains.
ex.zh: 飯店提供山區導覽遠足。
